title: 📄 Two papers from DM Lab have been accepted to ACM CIKM 2026 [BKCSA 3] (Short Paper Track)
author: Admin
content:
Two research papers from **DM Lab (Data Mining Lab)** have been accepted to **ACM CIKM 2026** (Short Paper Track) [BKCSA 3].

- **PRISM: Reliable LLM Knowledge Distillation from Graph-Context Perspectives for Text-Attributed Graph Learning**  
  *Junghyun Kim, Sobin Jung, David Y. Kang, Sang-Wook Kim*
- **Who Should Teach? Confidence-Aware Dual-Teacher Learning for Few-Shot Node Classification on Text-Attributed Graphs**  
  *Hojin Kim, Sujin Yoon, Sungsu Lim, Dongwon Lee, David Y. Kang*

Congratulations to the authors and the DM Lab research team on this outstanding achievement! 🎉

title: 💻 HCI Lab started a new research project 'CORAL' supported by NRF
author: Admin
content:
**HCI Lab (Human-Computer Interaction Lab)** has launched a new research project, **"CORAL: Development of Co-Regulation Agent Loop Technology for Daily Rhythm Recovery in Bipolar Disorder"**, supported by the **National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF)**.

We look forward to their impactful contributions and wish the HCI Lab research team great success with the new project! 🎉

title: 🧳 CBNU DxH Research Group members attended the 1st Data Intelligence × HCI Workshop @ UNIST
author: Admin
content:
Members of **CBNU DxH Research Group (DM Lab & HCI Lab)** participated in the **1st Data Intelligence × Human-Computer Interaction Workshop** (July 28–29, 2026) hosted at UNIST (Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology).

Faculty members and students from both labs shared their latest research findings and engaged in fruitful discussions on interdisciplinary research bridging data mining algorithms and interactive intelligent systems.

title: 👨‍🎓 Seungjun Park & Sujin Yoon transitioned to graduate students in DM Lab
author: Admin
content:

Please join us in congratulating both researchers and wishing them the very best on their academic and research journey! 🎓✨
